tasks.name: Use dates, JSON, heaps, and bisect

concepts.name: itertools.chain
concepts.description: `itertools.chain()` lazily presents multiple iterables as one sequence; `chain.from_iterable()` handles an outer iterable containing the inner iterables.

concepts.name: itertools.batched
concepts.description: `itertools.batched()` (Python 3.12+) lazily groups input into tuples; Python 3.13+ adds `strict=True` to reject an incomplete final batch.

concepts.name: itertools.pairwise
concepts.description: `itertools.pairwise()` (Python 3.10+) yields overlapping adjacent pairs and produces no pairs for input shorter than two values.

concepts.name: itertools.starmap
concepts.description: `itertools.starmap()` lazily expands each input item into positional arguments, unlike `map()` which passes each item as one argument.

concepts.name: pathlib path composition
concepts.description: `pathlib.Path` composes filesystem path segments with `/` and provides filesystem convenience methods; constructing a Path does not create or guarantee the target.

concepts.name: subprocess.run
concepts.description: `subprocess.run()` is the high-level child-process API; `check`, output capture, text decoding, argument lists, and shell usage control distinct execution and security behavior.

concepts.name: Timezone-aware datetimes
concepts.description: Aware datetimes carry explicit timezone information; use aware UTC values for instants and `astimezone()` to represent the same instant in another time zone.

concepts.name: json.dumps default hook
concepts.description: `json.dumps(default=...)` invokes a fallback serializer for unsupported objects, which must return a JSON-encodable replacement or raise `TypeError`.

concepts.name: heapq.nlargest
concepts.description: `heapq.nlargest()` selects the n largest items by an optional key and is most useful for relatively small n; `max()` and full sorting fit other sizes.

concepts.name: bisect.insort
concepts.description: `bisect.insort()` uses binary search to find an insertion point but list insertion remains O(n); bisect functions are not thread-safe on a shared sequence.
